message.content: The company faces the risk that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion, which would be confirmed if management states that the supply environment is less flexible than a year ago or if they describe revenue conversion as likely to be nonlinear over the next few quarters [D3]. The risk of one-time tariff impacts artificially inflating current profitability without repeating in future periods exists, which would be confirmed if executives caution that these specific impacts will not repeat in subsequent fiscal years [D3]. Additionally, the company risks failing to meet emerging industry requirements for AI safety in software-defined vehicles, a scenario confirmed if the collaboration with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York fails to produce evidence-driven approaches to support the implementation of ISO/PAS 8800 requirements or if they cannot generate auditable AI safety evidence [D7].
